codeReview.summary: The change correctly swaps VAL-CROSS-002 off the all-blocked fixture and adds mixed blocked-vs-at-risk assertions for overview, narrowed search, and reset. However, the new department-scope path still leaves a regression hole for goal-card blocked-owner signals: it does not assert that unrelated goal cards clear their blocked-owner callout when department scope narrows them to zero rows, so stale canonical blocked owners from the prior overview could still leak through while this test passes.

issues.description: After scoping to the Governance department, the test checks the Legal Framework card but never verifies that the unrelated Infrastructure goal card clears its blocked-owner signal for the narrowed subset. In app.js, goal cards are always rendered from the full frame set while their blocked-owner text is recomputed from the active subset (renderGoals uses frameGoals from appState.rows and activeGoalData from deriveGoalBuckets(rows)). A regression that left the Infrastructure card showing stale "Blocked: Mia Park" during department scope or after the "permit" search would still satisfy this test, so the feature does not fully prove the VAL-OVERVIEW-003 / VAL-BLOCKED-002 / VAL-CROSS-002 requirement that related goal-card blocked signals stay limited to canonical Blocked rows throughout the department-scope flow.

summary: Reviewed the handoff, transcript skeleton, skill instructions, commit 92850c4a3f0d6b6bea58cd99382a4e6013c88ddd, and the relevant app/test code. The feature improves coverage by moving the department-scope flow onto the mixed canonical-blocked fixture, but it still misses a blocking assertion on unrelated goal-card blocked-owner clearing during department narrowing, so the review fails.
